text:
Dani: Quick check — can we shift the weekly triage call start time by 15 minutes (from 09:45 -> 10:00 PT) so APAC folks can join without blocking their afternoons?
Sam: +1 from me, makes it easier to include Tokyo folks.
Kai: Works for infra, but we should keep the total duration the same (30m).
Olivia: tiny ask — can we add a 10m slot for RFC/design quick reviews? Often we punt small reviewers to next week.
Dani: Good call. Proposed compact agenda: 5m quick updates, 10m RFC/design lightning, 10m bug triage/owners, 5m action items. Stick to strict timers.
Ravi: Can we also add a "hotfix triage" flag in the backlog doc so that triage-bot surfaces true hot bugs? Right now a severity tag is inconsistent.
triage-bot: (automated) suggestion: add label `hotfix-needed` to issues with P0/P1 + regression.
Sam: Love the label idea. Also propose a 24h pre-triage checklist in Confluence so owners can pre-assign and add repro steps. Saves call time.
Olivia: I'll draft the checklist. Will link it in #eng agenda doc.
Dani: Thanks — Olivia, can you include a short template for "what I tried" + repro + stack trace? If owners pre-fill, triage can assign faster.
Olivia: Yep, will have a first pass by EOD Tuesday.
Kai: Operational note: if we move to 10:00 PT, can oncall shift their overlap window by 15m? @Ravi?
Ravi: We can nudge oncall rota by 15m for weekdays. I'll update the rota and ping SRE.
Sam: Small governance Q — who owns rotating bug assignments? Current pattern is inconsistent. Suggest 2-week owners per component and rotate on Mondays.
Dani: Agree. Let's set component owners list and rotate every other Monday. Olivia, can you put a owners table in the agenda doc (component -> owner -> backup)?
Olivia: On it. I'll include a column for "backup" and a checkbox for "pre-triage complete".
triage-bot: (automated) reminder: new agenda doc location -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/triage-agenda
Sam: One more: add a recurring "open floor" message in the channel 30m before the call for last-minute asks. People sometimes forget to post.
Dani: Good. I'll update the calendar invite: new time 10:00-10:30 PT starting next Monday, agenda link in invite, pre-triage checklist required for any issue to be discussed.
Ravi: Confirmed. I'll roll the rota change and add a note for APAC teams.
Sam: :thumbsup:
Olivia: Will post checklist draft and owners table by Tue EOD.
Dani: Thanks all — if no objections I'll make the calendar change by end of day.
Sam: No objections from me.
Kai: fine here.
Olivia: good.
